cases.root_cause: Over-etching during the PCB manufacturing process or mechanical stress causing a physical break in the trace path, leading to a NET_OPEN_DETECTED error.
resolution: Immediate rework action: Repair the broken trace section to restore electrical continuity.
Verification action: Perform continuity testing on the repaired trace to ensure the open circuit is resolved.
Process feedback action: Review the etching process parameters to prevent over-etching and evaluate mechanical handling procedures to minimize stress on the PCB.

cases.root_cause: Manufacturing defect causing incomplete etching or spurious copper deposition, resulting in isolated copper fragments that bridge adjacent electrical nets and cause short circuits.
resolution: Review and adjust etching process parameters to ensure complete removal of unintended copper.
Implement Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) to detect and flag spurious copper fragments immediately after the etching phase.
Rework affected boards by manually removing the spurious copper islands if feasible, otherwise scrap the defective units to prevent field failures.
